import json
from rest_api import RestAPI

api = RestAPI({"users": []})
# Add users
for name in ["Dan", "Adam", "Bob"]:
    print(api.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": name})))

# IOU 5.25 Adam lends Bob
print(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 5.25})))
# Another IOU to build up debt
print(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 2.75})))
# Reverse: Bob lends Adam 10 -> net Adam owes Bob 2
print(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 10.0})))
# Filter and sort
print(api.get("/users", json.dumps({"users": ["Adam", "Dan", "Bob"]})))
# All users
print(api.get("/users"))
# Floating point sanity (0.3 - 0.1)
api2 = RestAPI({"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {"Bob": 0.3}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -0.3},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Adam": 0.3}, "balance": 0.3},
]})
print(api2.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 0.1})))
print("database state:", json.dumps(api.database, indent=2))
EOF
